sloka: जीवन् न यदि ते अभ्येति ग्रहणम् मृग सत्तमः ।अजिनम् नरशार्दूल रुचिरम् तु भविष्यति ॥३-४३-१९॥
transliteration: jīvan na yadi te abhyeti grahaṇam mṛga sattamaḥ ।ajinam naraśārdūla ruciram tu bhaviṣyati ॥3-43-19॥

translations.english: If this animal is killed and its golden skin is spread on a tender grass cushion, there will I like to sit.
